provenance: recorded by sdrprobe, 2026-09-05, and cut to the first 2 000 000 bytes
decodes_to: MCC 268, MNC 3, colour code 17, location area 4375
notes: One of two, and the pair is the point: this cell's colour code is 17 and tetra_cc32.bin's is 32. The colour code is what the broadcast channel is scrambled with, so a decoder that hardcoded one would read this capture and fail the other -- the same argument that gives the GSM set three captures for three BCCs.
The carrier sits about 9 kHz above the tuning even with the site's 35 ppm correction applied, which is why tetra_coarse_offset_hz exists and is not optional.

The base station sends a synchronization burst in every timeslot, about seventy a second, so half a second carries roughly thirty-five. That is why a capture this short is enough; it is not a general property of TETRA.
The full three-second recording it was cut from decoded 202 of 202 synchronization blocks and 190 of 202 broadcast blocks, with the slot, frame and multiframe counters advancing.
